extension.summary: Personalised watchlists made from whatever you're in the mood for
extension.description: Tell curatr what you're in the mood for and create a watchlist with AI or lightweight Keyword Matching. Shape results around preferences from your Kodi Library, Trakt or both; organise Widget Folders; hide unwanted recommendations; and optionally connect Trakt, TMDB and MDBList. AI services include OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, OpenRouter and compatible providers.
extension.disclaimer: curatr sends prompts and likes / dislikes information to the services you enable. API keys and Trakt tokens are stored locally by Kodi and are never included in curatr backups.
